---
title: "Download AGFR"
---

AGFR is not distributed on its own. It is part of **ADFRsuite 1.0**, together with AutoDockFR,
AutoSite, AutoDock CrankPep 1.0, AutoGrid4, `prepare_receptor` and `prepare_ligand`.

**[Download and install ADFRsuite 1.0 →](/software/adfr/download.qmd)**

After installation, the AGFR programs are in `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin/`:

| Program | What it does |
|---|---|
| `agfrgui` | the graphical user interface |
| `agfr` | the command-line program |
| `about` | prints the metadata stored in a target file |

The [AutoDock CrankPep 1.1](/software/adcp/1.1/download.qmd) installer also installs `agfr` and
`agfrgui`.

## Tutorial data

The tutorials use the ADFRsuite tutorial data:
[ADFRsuite-1.0_tutorial_data.zip](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/adfrsuite-1.0-tutorials/ADFRsuite-1.0_tutorial_data.zip).
